_comment: Corrective action templates per hazard type. These are authored controls, not retrieved regulation text: regulation_reference points a reader at the applicable standard, it does not quote it. Retrieved clause text always comes from the regulatory index instead.

lockout_tagout.action: Stop all maintenance on the affected equipment until a machine-specific energy control procedure is posted at the machine.
lockout_tagout.rationale: Work continuing under the same conditions reproduces the exposure.

lockout_tagout.action: Issue individually keyed locks and tags to every authorised employee and verify a zero-energy state before any restart.
lockout_tagout.rationale: Shared or missing locks let a second person re-energise equipment under someone else.

lockout_tagout.action: Retrain authorised and affected employees on isolation, stored-energy release, and the verification step.
lockout_tagout.rationale: Isolation failures cluster around the verify step more than the lock step.

lockout_tagout.action: Add the annual periodic inspection of each energy control procedure to the EHS calendar with a named inspector.
lockout_tagout.rationale: Procedures drift from the equipment as machines are modified.

confined_space.action: Suspend all permit-required space entries pending atmospheric testing and a signed permit for each entry.
confined_space.rationale: Atmosphere in a closed space changes faster than an entrant can react.

confined_space.action: Post a trained attendant with a means of summoning rescue outside every occupied space.
confined_space.rationale: Most confined-space fatalities include a second victim who entered to help.

confined_space.action: Provide calibrated multi-gas monitors and document pre-entry and continuous monitoring results on the permit.
confined_space.rationale: An untested or uncalibrated instrument is indistinguishable from no test.

confined_space.action: Run a non-entry rescue drill with the retrieval system actually installed on site.
confined_space.rationale: Retrieval equipment that has never been rigged is rarely rigged correctly under pressure.

confined_space.action: Re-survey the site and reclassify every confined space, updating signage and the space inventory.
confined_space.rationale: Unlabelled spaces are entered as if they were ordinary work areas.

machine_guarding.action: Lock out and tag out of service every machine found with a removed, defeated or missing guard.
machine_guarding.rationale: An exposed point of operation injures on the first reach, not the hundredth.

machine_guarding.action: Prohibit jam clearing, cleaning and adjustment while any machine is running.
machine_guarding.rationale: Reaching into a running machine is the dominant mechanism in caught-in injuries.

machine_guarding.action: Audit every machine in the area for guarding at the point of operation, nip points and rotating parts; log each finding to closure.
machine_guarding.rationale: A defeated guard on one machine usually reflects a production pressure affecting the whole line.

machine_guarding.action: Fit interlocked guards or presence-sensing devices on machines where frequent access is genuinely required.
machine_guarding.rationale: Guards removed for access stay removed; design out the need instead.

fall_protection.action: Stop work at height and install guardrails, covers or a compliant personal fall arrest system at every exposed edge and opening.
fall_protection.rationale: Falls are the leading cause of construction fatalities and are fatal from low heights.

fall_protection.action: Inspect and remove from service all harnesses, lanyards and anchor points showing damage or exceeded date.
fall_protection.rationale: Arrest equipment fails silently until it is loaded.

fall_protection.action: Train every exposed worker on hazard recognition, anchorage selection and the correct use of the site systems.
fall_protection.rationale: Harnesses worn but not tied off are a training failure, not an equipment failure.

fall_protection.action: Write a site fall-protection plan that names anchorage points and rescue arrangements before work at height is scheduled.
fall_protection.rationale: Post-arrest suspension trauma needs a plan made in advance.

chemical_release.action: Isolate and depressurise the affected system; restrict access to the release area until the atmosphere is verified clear.
chemical_release.rationale: Secondary exposure during response is common after a release.

chemical_release.action: Verify every relief path on the affected system is unobstructed and correctly set.
chemical_release.rationale: A blocked relief path converts an upset into a rupture.

chemical_release.action: Review mechanical integrity records for the failed component and inspect comparable equipment on the same service.
chemical_release.rationale: Corrosion and erosion affect a whole service, not one fitting.

chemical_release.action: Reconcile the process safety information and P&IDs against the equipment as it is actually installed.
chemical_release.rationale: Undocumented modifications defeat every downstream hazard review.

chemical_release.action: Require a management-of-change review with sign-off for any process, equipment or procedural change, including temporary repairs.
chemical_release.rationale: Temporary changes that outlive their review are a recurring cause of major releases.

fire_explosion.action: Remove accumulated combustible dust from all horizontal surfaces using approved non-sparking methods.
fire_explosion.rationale: Settled dust supplies the secondary explosion that causes most of the damage.

fire_explosion.action: Restore any impaired fire detection or suppression system to service, or post a continuous fire watch until it is.
fire_explosion.rationale: An impaired system removes the last barrier while the hazard is highest.

fire_explosion.action: Re-verify the hazardous-area electrical classification and replace non-rated equipment inside classified zones.
fire_explosion.rationale: Non-rated equipment is a standing ignition source in a flammable atmosphere.

fire_explosion.action: Commission a dust hazard analysis or equivalent combustible-material assessment for the facility.
fire_explosion.rationale: Housekeeping alone does not address the equipment that generates the dust.

electrical.action: De-energise and lock out the affected circuits; prohibit energized work without a written energized-work permit.
electrical.rationale: Working live is the single largest contributor to arc-flash injury.

electrical.action: Remove damaged cords, tools and enclosures with missing covers from service.
electrical.rationale: Exposed conductors are an uncontrolled contact hazard for everyone nearby.

electrical.action: Issue arc-rated PPE matched to the incident energy of each panel and label panels with the calculated rating.
electrical.rationale: PPE selection is impossible without a posted incident-energy value.

electrical.action: Complete an arc-flash study and set up a periodic revalidation cycle after electrical system changes.
electrical.rationale: System changes invalidate previous incident-energy calculations.

struck_by.action: Physically separate pedestrian routes from mobile equipment routes with barriers and marked crossings.
struck_by.rationale: Administrative controls alone do not survive a busy shift.

struck_by.action: Prohibit any work or travel beneath a suspended load.
struck_by.rationale: Rigging failure gives no warning and no time to move.

struck_by.action: Require a spotter for all reversing and blind-lift operations and verify operator certification.
struck_by.rationale: Blind-side travel is the dominant mechanism in powered-truck fatalities.

struck_by.action: Fit proximity detection or camera systems to mobile plant that routinely operates near people.
struck_by.rationale: Engineering controls persist when supervision does not.

hot_work.action: Halt all hot work until a permit system with a pre-work hazard check is in force.
hot_work.rationale: The permit is the only step that forces the area survey.

hot_work.action: Assign a fire watch during the work and for at least 30 minutes after it finishes.
hot_work.rationale: Most hot-work fires are discovered after the crew has left.

hot_work.action: Remove or shield combustibles within the required radius and confirm containers and lines are gas free before cutting.
hot_work.rationale: Residue in a vessel ignites from the first spark.

hot_work.action: Establish designated hot-work areas so routine cutting and welding leaves the production floor.
hot_work.rationale: Fixed areas remove the permit decision from time-pressured crews.

material_handling.action: Down-rate or remove from service any lifting equipment or rack loaded beyond its marked capacity.
material_handling.rationale: Capacity exceedance compounds with every subsequent lift.

material_handling.action: Remove damaged slings, chains and hooks from service and tag them for destruction.
material_handling.rationale: Damaged rigging returned to the crib will be used again.

material_handling.action: Restack stored material to stable heights on level footing and mark maximum stacking heights.
material_handling.rationale: Stack collapse injures people who are not part of the task.

material_handling.action: Introduce mechanical lifting aids for routinely handled loads and review task design.
material_handling.rationale: Repeated manual handling produces cumulative injury that no training prevents.

general.action: Stop the task that produced the incident until the specific hazard is controlled or the work is re-planned.
general.rationale: The conditions that produced one incident are still present for the next shift.

general.action: Brief every affected crew on what happened and what has changed before they return to the area.
general.rationale: Workers cannot avoid a hazard nobody has described to them.

general.action: Complete a documented root-cause investigation covering the management-system failure, not only the immediate act.
general.rationale: Stopping at the immediate cause leaves the system that produced it intact.

general.action: Verify training records for everyone performing the task and close any gap before they resume it.
general.rationale: Untrained exposure is the most frequently cited contributing factor.

general.action: Add the identified precursor conditions as explicit checks in the routine inspection programme.
general.rationale: Precursors are only useful once someone is looking for them on a schedule.
